Name: Maggie WAR Complete
Description: Complete Warrior event profile based on Jasper's dungeon-and-raid structure and checked against BossMod priorities. Opener stays enabled; Save CD is manual only; Beast Gauge protection, spenders, interrupts and mitigation remain enabled.

Events.Name: Emergency Holmgang
Events.Description: Uses Holmgang before lethal low-HP windows.

Events.Name: Second Pack Mitigation
Events.Description: Adds the second mitigation layer only if a large pull keeps pressuring HP, preserving staggered coverage.

Events.Name: First Pack Mitigation
Events.Description: Begins the dungeon mitigation ladder near 80 percent HP on 3+ enemy pulls, leaving room for later tools.

Events.Name: Final Boss Check
Events.Description: Allows final burn behavior once the boss is near 5 percent HP.

Events.Name: Co-tank Support
Events.Description: Optional co-tank support using Nascent Flash. Disabled by default; enable when you want buddy mitigation support.

Events.Name: Bloodwhetting / Raw Intuition
Events.Description: Uses Bloodwhetting or Raw Intuition proactively around 85 percent HP on 3+ enemy AoE packs.

Events.Name: Equilibrium Recovery
Events.Description: Uses Equilibrium around 70 percent HP as an oGCD recovery layer before emergency windows.

Events.Name: Wipe Reset OT Stance
Events.Description: Optional off-tank stance release, left disabled by default.

Events.Name: Interject Cast Stop
Events.Description: Stops interruptible enemy casts with Interject when in range.

Events.Name: Reprisal Mobs
Events.Description: Uses Reprisal in large dungeon pulls when it is not already active.

Events.Name: Arm's Length Pack Slow
Events.Description: Uses Arm's Length on normal dungeon pulls when you are stationary and the targets should live long enough.

Events.Name: Sprint Between Pulls
Events.Description: Optional between-pull Sprint helper. It is off by default.

Events.Name: Out-of-Combat Reset
Events.Description: Returns Warrior ACR toggles to their standard out-of-combat state.

Events.Name: Zone Reset
Events.Description: Warrior defaults are reapplied after changing zones.

Events.Name: Wipe Reset
Events.Description: Warrior defaults are reapplied after a wipe.

Events.Name: Nascent Flash Lowest
Events.Description: Optional Nascent Flash support for the lowest-health party member around 50 percent HP.

Events.Name: Wipe Reset MT Stance
Events.Description: Main-tank stance setup for roulettes and dungeon pulls.

Events.Name: Zone Reset MT Stance
Events.Description: Reapplies main-tank stance setup after changing zones.

Events.Name: Manual Provoke Swap
Events.Description: Manual Provoke moves the profile into MT behavior, enables Defiance, and spends Bloodwhetting as a light swap defensive.

Events.Name: MT Loose-Add Pickup
Events.Description: Main-tank loose-add pickup. Requires Defiance, so stance-off OT play will not Provoke.

Events.Name: Thrill Pack Recovery
Events.Description: Uses Thrill of Battle around 70 percent HP as a pack-sustain layer on 3+ enemy pulls.

Events.Name: Shake Pack Recovery
Events.Description: Uses Shake It Off around 65 percent HP as a pack-sustain shield on 3+ enemy pulls.

Events.Name: Spender Toggle Safety
Events.Description: Maintains Warrior spender toggles enabled in combat so Beast Gauge and primal spenders do not sit unused.

Events.Name: AoE Pack Spender Release
Events.Description: Turns Save CD and Save 1 Jump off, re-enables normal UseAOE, then re-enables spender toggles during three-or-more enemy pulls.

Events.Name: High Gauge Spender Release
Events.Description: Releases spender holds at 80+ Beast Gauge to avoid overcap.

Conditions.Name: [Aggro] >= 2 Mob
Conditions.Description: Tank has at least two active enemies for add-pickup support.

Conditions.Name: Beast Gauge >= 80
Conditions.Description: Warrior Beast Gauge is high enough that Save CD should release to prevent overcap.

Conditions.Name: [Target] HP >= 45%
Conditions.Description: Releases cooldown holds once the current target is no longer in end-of-pack/end-of-boss range.

Conditions.Name: Auto Buddymit
Conditions.Description: Condition requiring tank partner to be in combat with you.

Conditions.Name: Bloodwhetting Pack <= 85%
Conditions.Description: AoE-pack HP threshold for proactive Bloodwhetting or Raw Intuition.

Conditions.Name: Does not have Thrill of Battle

SubConditions.Name: Does not have Thrill of Battle

Conditions.Name: Not Top Aggro
Conditions.Description: Current enemy target is not locked to the tank, used for MT add pickup.

Conditions.Name: Defiance Active
Conditions.Description: Requires Defiance to be active so OT mode with stance off cannot Provoke or ranged-pull loose adds.

Conditions.Name: Manual Provoke Used
Conditions.Description: Detects a recent manual Provoke as a tank-swap request.

Logics.Name: Automit TB
Logics.Description: Tankbuster mitigation selector.

Logics.Name: Emergency Holmgang
Logics.Description: Uses Holmgang around 30 percent HP before lethal low-HP windows.

Logics.Name: Double Mit
Logics.Description: Second pack mitigation gate: HP near 65 percent with 3+ enemies.

Logics.Name: Single Mit
Logics.Description: First pack mitigation gate: HP near 80 percent with 3+ enemies.

Logics.Name: Bloodwhetting / Raw Intuition
Logics.Description: Uses Bloodwhetting or Raw Intuition proactively around 85 percent HP on 3+ enemy AoE packs, without blocking on the current target HP.

Logics.Name: Equilibrium Recovery
Logics.Description: Uses Equilibrium around 70 percent HP as an oGCD recovery layer before emergency windows.

Logics.Name: Stance OT
Logics.Description: Optional off-tank stance release, left disabled by default.

Logics.Name: Interject Interrupt
Logics.Description: Stops interruptible enemy casts with Interject when in range.

Logics.Name: Reprisal Mobs
Logics.Description: Uses Reprisal in large dungeon pulls when it is not already active.

Logics.Name: Arm's Length Mitigation
Logics.Description: Arm's Length gate for 3+ enemy pulls.

Logics.Name: Sprint OOC
Logics.Description: Optional out-of-combat Sprint quality-of-life toggle. Disabled by default.

Logics.Name: Reset Toggles
Logics.Description: Returns Warrior ACR toggles to their standard out-of-combat state. Regular UseAOE stays enabled; ForceAOE remains manual and is not changed by this profile.

Logics.Name: Nascent Flash Lowest
Logics.Description: Optional Nascent Flash support for the lowest-health party member around 50 percent HP.

Logics.Name: Stance MT
Logics.Description: Main-tank stance setup for roulettes and dungeon pulls.

Logics.Name: Thrill Pack Recovery
Logics.Description: Uses Thrill of Battle around 70 percent HP as a pack-sustain layer on 3+ enemy pulls, avoiding unnecessary boss/TB overlap.

Logics.Name: Shake Pack Recovery
Logics.Description: Uses Shake It Off around 65 percent HP as a pack-sustain shield on 3+ enemy pulls, avoiding unnecessary boss/TB overlap.

Logics.Name: Spender Toggle Safety
Logics.Description: Maintains Warrior spender toggles in combat and releases Save 1 Jump so Beast Gauge and primal spenders do not sit unused after a bad local toggle state.

Logics.Name: AoE Pack Spender Release
Logics.Description: Turns Save CD and Save 1 Jump off during three-or-more enemy pulls, re-enables normal UseAOE, then re-enables Warrior spender toggles so Beast Gauge and primal spenders do not sit unused through trash packs.

Logics.Name: High Gauge Spender Release
Logics.Description: Releases Save CD and Save 1 Jump at high Beast Gauge, then re-enables Warrior spender toggles so gauge does not sit capped.

Logics.Name: MT Add Pickup
Logics.Description: Uses Provoke plus Warrior's ranged pull action to help pick up loose adds only while Defiance is active; OT mode with stance off will not taunt.

Logics.Name: Manual Provoke Tank Swap
Logics.Description: Manual Provoke is treated as a tank-swap request: turns Defiance / MT stance on and uses one short self-mitigation tool.

Items.Name: Last Boss
Items.Description: Enables burn boss at 5 percent HP boss health. Enable this for the last boss of a dungeon, or for any trial/raid with only one phase.

Items.Name: Opener
Items.Description: Optional automatic opener reset support after wipes.

Items.Name: Stun/Int
Items.Description: Uses Low Blow and Interject for general-duty dungeon utility.

Items.Name: Auto TB
Items.Description: Selects tankbuster mitigation for the incoming hit.

Items.Name: Buddy Mit
Items.Description: Optional Nascent Flash co-tank/ally support. Leave off when you want Bloodwhetting reserved for yourself.

Items.Name: MT Stance
Items.Description: Main-tank stance setup for roulettes and dungeons, with loose-add pickup included. Manual Provoke also switches into this MT behavior.

Items.Name: OT Stance
Items.Description: Optional off-tank stance release; manual Provoke is treated as a tank swap and turns MT stance back on.
